model: Three-seed fine_consistent ensemble; per-locus OOF models
gradient: Mean true-class logit gradient for rep1; magnitude normalized jointly across3views per example
example_choice: First encountered held-out example of each type; no success filtering
occlusion: Center32x32 versus four16x16corners, both zero and training-OE1 neutral fill; near diagonals re-masked; repeat probabilities averaged
limitations: Sensitivity diagnostics, not causal proof or calibrated attention
Zero occlusion creates atypical holes; neutral counterpart retained
Fixed equal-pixel masks cover different physical lengths in the three views
True-class gradient is shown even if the model predicts a different class
